svg.text: Long leg to minus: common cathode.
Common anode: long leg to OUT+.
220–470 µF across VCC and GND, + on VCC
plus: battery, 3.3 V, buzzer, one lead of each motor
minus: ground, the other lead of each motor
Not to scale. Follow the names printed on your boards:
the order of the pads can differ from this drawing.
